title: Bright Angel Flash Flood (55504573056)
description:
Water flows down a canyon wall and floods a path in the Bright Angel Creek area during the flash flood, August 29, 2026.
Video by NPS/K.Hensel

Description: Heavy rain is coming down, and water flows down a canyon wall. The sky is completely grey. At :03 the camera zooms out and then pans right to a path with stones lining it. The path is completely flooded with water running down it. The camera person walks up the flooded path. At :18 the camera pans right to the other side of the canyon that has streams of water running down it. No audio.
